summary: Built a TLS-secured Vault Transit provider on node1 and a three-voter integrated-Raft Vault cluster on node2-node4. Transit auto-unseal, KV v2 proof data, failover, voter recovery, administrative environments, and restart persistence are verified.
actions_performed: Installed Vault 2.1.1 and configured systemd services on all four nodes.
Created a private CA and node-specific certificates with validated hostname/IP SANs.
Configured node1 with the Transit engine and autounseal encryption key.
Configured node2-node4 as a three-member integrated-Raft cluster using Transit auto-unseal.
Enabled KV v2 at secret/ and stored proof=raft-auto-unseal at secret/infraset.
Created root-only /root/vault-admin.env files on every Raft member.
Stopped one Raft leader, verified continued availability, restored it, and confirmed voter recovery.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Validated TLS on all Vault nodes
evidence.summary: All node certificates validate against the private CA and contain the appropriate hostname and managed-IP SANs.

evidence.requirement: Vault Transit seal provider on node1
evidence.summary: Transit is enabled with the autounseal key; node1 recovered after a service restart, and a Raft member successfully used Transit over TLS.
node2-node4 are initialized, unsealed, using Raft HA, and form a three-voter cluster.
secret/ is KV version 2 and secret/infraset contains proof=raft-auto-unseal.

evidence.requirement: Administrative access variables on every Raft member
evidence.summary: Each member has a mode-0600 root-owned vault-admin.env containing VAULT_ADDR, VAULT_CACERT, and a valid administrative VAULT_TOKEN.

evidence.requirement: Availability with one Raft member down and voter recovery
evidence.summary: After node2 was stopped, node4 became leader and proof remained readable; node2 then recovered unsealed and returned as a voter.
Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered unsealed Transit service with its key intact.
Boot ID changed; node2 auto-unsealed, retained proof data, and recovered as a voter.
Boot ID changed; node3 auto-unsealed, retained proof data, and recovered as a voter.
Boot ID changed; node4 auto-unsealed, retained proof data, and recovered as a voter; the cluster returned to three healthy voters.
